request.control_dir: directory in which the probe worker writes phase-NNN.json markers and waits for phase-NNN.release
request.root: directory under which every mount of the lifecycle happens

phase_marker.name: phase name
phase_marker.worker: the worker identity (must equal the live /proc identity)

expected.mounts: [{target, mountId, deviceId, root, filesystem, kernelSource, readonly}] claimed by the production adapter readback
expected.absent_devices: [path] loop/dm devices that must be released
expected.reader: [path] read by an nsenter reader inside the worker mount namespace
expected.syscalls: [{name, return_class, count|"any"}] mount-family syscalls the production adapter issued since the previous release

response.runner: provenance: runner_sha256, command, process_id, mode=external, self_comparison=false, implementation, started_at, finished_at
response.mountinfo: content-bound comparisons per claimed mount (line, line_sha256, expected, actual, digests, passed)
response.syscalls: content-bound comparisons per observed syscall (name, return, errno, args)
response.container_observation: content-bound comparisons per in-namespace reader (id, pid, mount_namespace_inode)
